items: Music Studio now speaks 17 languages: English plus French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Croatian, German, Chinese, Ukrainian, Esperanto, Swahili, Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian, Urdu, Farsi and Arabic. Pick yours under the font choice in Settings; it applies to every app by this maker. The other languages are machine translated and unchecked.
Numbers, prices and dates now follow your language and region, and Arabic, Farsi and Urdu lay the app out right to left.
While Google Drive sync is on, your Google picture now sits at the top of the app on every screen, so you can always see which account is syncing. Tap it to open the sync settings.
A new default font, Atkinson Hyperlegible, chosen for easy reading. Change it in Settings; the choice applies to every app by this maker on this device.
About this app (under the font choice) shows the version, where your data lives, how much storage it uses, and a Copy diagnostics button for reporting a problem.
You are told when a new version is ready, and if something goes wrong you see a message with a Reload button instead of a frozen screen.
When Google Drive is connected, your Google profile picture shows beside the account.
Settings has an Erase everything button that removes all Music Studio data from this browser, after asking. Your backup folder and Drive are not touched.
The spend log files each charge under your local day, so a late-evening generation no longer counts toward tomorrow.
AI cowork sync now shows the agent's advice for review before it replaces yours, can run on a schedule from one computer, keeps a history, and can undo.
Ratings, notes and a taste profile that agents can read; bulk actions in the Library; finetunes from your own songs.
Takes, composition plans, redoing a single section, seeds, a lyrics quality check, and a confirmation before spending credits.
